question: Does the frozen 32-feature shared representation transfer to earlier historical cutoffs with matched candidate generation and ranking controls?
exposure: The original baseline research already inspected these calendar windows. This is new-feature temporal replication, not an untouched holdout. Overlapping windows are not independent datasets.
sampling_contract: Freeze whole-session IDs and fitting negatives before reading selection metrics. Preserve exactly matched rows across arms. Any later seed replication must record whether it changes sampled data, model randomness, or both; identical inputs/models are not independent evidence.

execution.next_action: Verify earlier-window corpus/retriever artifacts, then build and audit features for 256 complete queries per role before any ranker fit. Measure loading/build time and peak memory, then a 1,024-session sample before extrapolating to the target cohort.
execution.ranker_phase: Six models per window. Inspect and checkpoint the early result before launching the middle window.

preflight_required: Every graph and item statistic fitted strictly before that window history_end; reference-window graphs cannot be reused.
No new feature screening, routing, block removal or model search on the replication cohorts.
Full candidate features computed before fitting-negative sampling; target denominators retain all eligible future labels.
Input hashes, source hashes, schema and candidate identities verified; 256-query smoke and partial/complete replay pass.
Resource estimate from measured smoke throughput fits the next bounded stage; checkpoint on every completed partition/model.
advance_from_early_if: Shared weighted point gain is at least 0.001 and order recall does not decline. Otherwise stop expansion and diagnose; never change the frozen schema to rescue this replication.
promotion: No promotion from a single point gate. Require stable objective-level gains, uncertainty assessment with overlap/exposure declared, training-support checks and an independent audit. The broader feature-family completion gate remains open.
